# Close app (`app.close`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Apps & scripts · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Asks an app to close, like clicking its X button. With force: true it is ended if it does not close in time.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | App patterns to close. |
| `force` | true / false | no | `false` | End the app if it has not closed after the timeout. Unsaved work is lost. |
| `timeout` | duration (`30s`, `5m`, `1h30m`) | no | `10s` | How long to wait for the app to close before forcing it. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: app.close
    app: Discord.exe
    force: true
```
